job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled Senior LLM/RAG Engineer with 5 to 10 years of experience in Legacy Modernization to join our team at GRID DYNAMICS PRIVATE LIMITED. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in legacy systems and RAG engineering.

Roles and Responsibility
Design, develop, and implement legacy modernization solutions using various tools and technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.
Develop and maintain technical documentation for legacy systems and RAG projects.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to legacy systems and RAG projects.
Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
Mentor junior engineers and provide guidance on legacy systems and RAG engineering.
Job Requirements
Strong understanding of legacy systems and RAG engineering principles and practices.
Experience with various tools and technologies used in legacy modernization.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong analytical and technical skills.
